prompt_verbatim: Draw one full-body side-view pixel-art in-between animation frame of Ultraman Type C, head right. Start from the supported-on-back pose in reference 1, which is shown in context in reference 2. Work BACKWARD toward the earlier pose in reference 3: both THIGHS must stay full natural length and swing down from the hips toward LEFT and slightly DOWN, with BOTH knees positioned visibly left and below the pelvis. Both calves bend continuing left-down, feet farther left and lower than the knees. The thighs themselves move: do not merely fold the feet back while leaving knees to the right of the pelvis. Keep the raised head, upper torso, two rear-tucked arms and abdomen support very close to reference 1; do not rotate the whole character into flying. Reference 4 defines identity, suit markings and proportions. Exactly two continuous arms and two legs, natural anatomy, blue chest light. Full isolated character only, no monster, no panels, no text, no extra object, sharp 2D pixel art, transparent background.
